headlines.headline: 101 Days to Tip-Off: Duke's Schedule Looms Brutal, Florida's Golden Chases a Repeat Title
headlines.detail: Duke Basketball Report flagged a brutal slate including ACC rivals Louisville, Virginia, Miami and UNC. Florida's Todd Golden chases back-to-back titles; Tennessee transfer Jalen Haralson looks to expand his game.

headlines.headline: Curry Signs Below-Max $112M Warriors Extension as Camps Open
headlines.detail: Stephen Curry inked a two-year, $112 million extension to stay in Golden State. Suns forward Dillon Brooks was charged with DUI; D'Angelo Russell signed with the Shanghai Sharks after being waived by Memphis.

headlines.headline: Dolphins' Achane Out for Season With Torn ACL as Falcons Lock Up Dexter for $78M
headlines.detail: Miami RB De'Von Achane suffered a season-ending ACL tear. Atlanta signed DT Gervon Dexter to a four-year, $78M extension; Drake Maye and Justin Jefferson both landed on injury reports.

headlines.headline: Texas Holds No. 1 at 4-0 as CFP Model Gives SEC a 39% Title Shot Over Big Ten's 38%
headlines.detail: ESPN's model has Ohio State as the single best bet at 17%. Georgia needed two pick-sixes to beat Oklahoma 41-13; Iowa hosts Ohio State Saturday after surviving Michigan.
